page.layout: One printed page: a title block centred inside a woodcut architectural border, with no other printed text.

main_text.l: NO SS. Theologiæ in inclytâ Gene-
Ad diem 19. Augusti horâ locóque solitis.

page.notes: Handwritten red-ink numeral "18" at the top right of the title block, beside "THEOLOGICA": handwriting, not transcribed. Faint show-through of the reverse page is visible in the white space around the border: not transcribed. The printed "VI-/RO" and "TVRRETTI-/NO" and "Gene-/vensium" and "do-/ctissimo" splits are line-end hyphens kept as printed. The V/U spellings were normalised by rule (DISPUTATIO, IACOBUS, DORVILLIUS, AQUISGRANENSIS, Genevensium, Reverendo); the printed forms were DISPVTATIO, IACOBVS, DORVILLIVS, AQVISGRANENSIS, Geneuensium, Reuerendo.
